cita: Kwon (2026). Manufactured Confidence: How Memory Consolidation Turns Hearsay into Confident Facts.
problema: Memory products (mem0, LangMem) extract 'facts' from conversation and store them for later steps to trust, but this fact-extraction rewriting manufactures confidence: a casual, hedged remark becomes a confident, dated assertion the agent then obeys as verified, without any attacker needed whenever a once-true hedge goes stale and its correction is never stored.
mecanismo: A multi-step agent loop where an early conclusion is compressed into carried memory (source removed, as real consolidation works); the paper cross-varies source attribution (bare/attributed/forged-authority) against phrasing register (assertive/hedged/evidential/explicit-non-verification) to isolate what the agent actually keys on, tests two mitigations at the store (passive 'unverified' tag vs. active 'distrust' instruction) against a redundant-source check (an authoritative directory lookup), and reproduces the same de-hedging both via natural cross-session staleness and via a one-line adversarial injection laundered through mem0/LangMem.
evaluacion: Five models across four providers (claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5, llama-3.1-70b, gpt-4o-mini, qwen-2.5-72b), judge-free (ground truth by construction), multi-step computation and two decision-agent settings (budget-approval, access-control); tests natural staleness (mem0/LangMem sessions with/without in-context correction) and a one-line memory-poisoning injection; source-vs-phrasing framing cross (n=12x6), hedge-cue decomposition (modality/hearsay/explicit-non-verification, n=12x6), and a redundant-source ablation (n=6x5).
numeros_clave: Confident framings grant unauthorized access at 0.81 regardless of source (bare, attributed, or forged 'system of record'), while every hedge collapses grants to 0.00-0.40 (Table 1); natural staleness without injection grants on 0.69 (mem0) / 0.75 (LangMem) of requests when no in-context correction exists (Table 3); both consolidating products launder an injected hedge into a confident fact at 100% (Table 7) vs 0% for a verbatim-storage control; a redundant authoritative-directory check restores wrong-grant to 0.00 with no escalation (Table 2), versus distrust-alone escalating 100% of correct decisions (Table 8).

mf_aplicabilidad.nota: Directly challenges naive negative-knowledge tagging: a passive 'unverified' label leaves the assertion's confidence intact and is ignored (Table 6, leak ~0.37-0.38), while an active 'distrust' instruction only abdicates (escalates 100% of even correct memories, Table 8) -- MF's NEGATIVO mechanism must preserve tentative phrasing AT WRITE TIME, not annotate confidently-phrased memory afterward.

Shows fact-extraction consolidation itself manufactures unwarranted confidence: both real products (mem0, LangMem) de-hedge a casual remark into a flat, dated fact at a 100% laundering rate (Table 7) -- a direct challenge to any MF consolidation step that summarizes raw text into 'facts' without preserving epistemic status.

The only mitigation that actually works is redundancy, not annotation: adding a second authoritative source (directory lookup) restores correct discrimination (wrong-grant 0.00, no escalation, Table 2) where memory-only distrust just abdicates -- a concrete pattern that no single memory should be load-bearing for a consequential MF decision.

notes: Table 1 (source-vs-phrasing cross) and Table 13 (hedge-cue decomposition) are the load-bearing, non-obvious evidence; hearsay register ('reportedly') is the near-universal blind spot across models. No membership doubt.

cita: Wang, K., & Zhang, C. (2026). MemLeak: Diagnosing Information Leaks in Multimodal Agent Memory.
problema: When a multimodal agent is asked to forget a fact, current memory systems delete the text entry and report success, but the fact can remain recoverable from retained user images -- including images tagged to entirely different facts -- because VLMs exploit implicit visual cues at inference time that no storage-level deletion mechanism targets.
mecanismo: The Information Provenance Graph (IPG) models each fact's propagation across memory layers (text entry, text embedding, image file, image embedding, graph edges, implicit visual features, derived facts, behavioral patterns) as a DAG whose nodes carry a deletion affordance (addr=directly addressable, link=deletable only via a maintained provenance link, unreach=persistent/outside storage-level deletion scope); the MemLeak benchmark probes each layer (same-fact recovery, retained-image recovery, cross-image reconstruction, behavioral residue) and measures whether content-aware semantic deletion (flagging and removing images correlated with the deleted fact) reduces the persistent-node residual.
evaluacion: 113 synthetic profiles (2,260 facts) for text-only scale evaluation across 5 systems (Long-context, Naive, Mem0-prod, Letta-sim, Oracle); 38 multimodal profiles (n=300 probes) with a 3-model LLM judge ensemble (GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Flash) cross-validated against dual human annotators (kappa=0.88); cross-model generality (Claude Sonnet 4 vs GPT-4o), real Unsplash-photo validation, and an end-to-end Mem0 pipeline test.
numeros_clave: Retained-image recovery after full text+tagged-image deletion is 12.0% (36/300, 95% CI [8.8,16.2]) vs 0.0% blind baseline and 0.3% FPR on negative controls; 47% of image leaks (17/36) are not recoverable from retained text alone; content-aware semantic deletion reduces the image residual from 12.0% to 2.0% at 21.0% retained-image cost; end-to-end Mem0 pipeline leaks 16.3%; real Unsplash photos replicate at 10.6% (consistent, overlapping CIs); retained-text-only inference leaks 18.3%.

mf_aplicabilidad.nota: Challenges the assumption that 'delete the text entry = forgotten': the IPG shows deletion succeeds on addressable/linked nodes but persistent nodes (implicit visual features) survive by design, so 12.0% of deleted facts remain recoverable from retained images tagged to OTHER facts (Table 4) -- negative knowledge ('this was forgotten') does not propagate across representation layers by default.

Content-aware semantic deletion (auditing correlated retained content across representations, not just the tagged text entry) reduces the persistent residual from 12.0% to 2.0% (S2.3) -- a concrete deletion-completeness check MF could adopt for any fact stored across multiple representations, not only images.

The Information Provenance Graph's addr/link/unreach taxonomy tracking one fact across text, embeddings, images, and graph edges (Definition 1, S2.2) is a reusable cross-representation provenance model relevant to MF's COSTURAS need for a single-source-of-truth-per-fact across multi-store memory.

notes: Explicitly scoped as a benchmark/measurement, not a theory of impossibility (S1); Table 1 (per-architecture) and Table 4 (forgetting-residual decomposition) are load-bearing. No membership doubt.

cita: Leong (2026). Forensic Trajectory Signatures for Agent Memory Poisoning Detection.
problema: Existing defenses against agent memory poisoning require store access, white-box model internals, or retrieval-layer intervention before injection, but many operators cannot meet these infrastructure demands, leaving no way to forensically detect a memory-channel attack from tool-call logs alone, the way classical EDR detects compromise from process traces without inspecting memory contents.
mecanismo: A behavioral invariant is discovered and mechanistically explained: a delayed-trigger memory-poisoning attack must call memory recall_fact to retrieve an attacker's routing address before it can call the exfiltrating send_email, a transition non-exfiltrating sessions rarely exhibit; 19 trajectory features (counts, structural binaries, bigram transitions, entry points) extracted from tool-call operation names/ordering/timestamps alone (never contents) feed a classifier, and feature-group ablation plus cross-model leave-one-out hold-out test whether the signature is overdetermined and model-agnostic.
evaluacion: 2,520 labeled runs (9 open-source models x 7 defense conditions x 40 runs) from a prior delayed-trigger-attack factorial; three classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosted Trees) under stratified 5-fold CV with BCa bootstrap CIs; leave-one-model-out cross-model hold-out on 9 models (7B-120B); feature-group ablation removing all recall-related features; frontier validation on GPT-4.1 (N=20, no retraining); an evasion-boundary check against prompt-injection-only attacks.
numeros_clave: The single-rule invariant alone (recall_before_send) achieves AUC=0.9563; the full 19-feature Random Forest reaches AUC=0.9904 (BCa 95% CI [0.987,0.993]); removing all 9 recall-related features leaves AUC unchanged at 0.9904 (overdetermined signature); cross-model hold-out reaches AUC=1.000 on 6/9 models, with all 3 exceptions mechanistically explained; a prefix-only variant reaches AUC=0.934; prompt-injection-only attacks score 0.541, distinct from the 1.000 mean score on memory-channel attacks.

mf_aplicabilidad.nota: A mechanistically-forced behavioral invariant (recall-before-send) lets a detector diagnose memory-channel poisoning from tool-call operation names/ordering alone (AUC=0.9904), with zero access to memory content, model weights, or activations -- a cheap, content-blind auditing pattern MF could adopt for FIDELIDAD monitoring on any retrieval-then-act pipeline.

Detection requires only tool-call logs (operation names, ordering, counts, timestamps), never memory contents or an extra model call (S2.1), a cheap forensic signal relevant to MF's context-economy framing, though the paper reports no absolute latency/token cost.

notes: All 31 false negatives concentrate exclusively in the Memory Sandbox defense condition, mechanistically explained (Table 5, S3.5); qwq:32b's AUC=0.000 hold-out is an informative out-of-scope failure (bypasses the memory-recall step entirely), not a signature failure. No membership doubt.

cita: Halaharvi (2026). HyphaeDB: A Living Knowledge Topology for Agent-First Memory.
problema: Existing vector databases and agent memory frameworks treat memory as passive storage that agents query explicitly, with no mechanism to propagate knowledge between agents through the memory layer itself, no awareness of which agents need what information, and no capacity for emergent multi-agent coordination.
mecanismo: HyphaeDB reinterprets the HNSW graph (the ANN index inside most vector databases) as a gossip communication fabric: agents are nodes with positions drifting via a salience/recency-weighted centroid of recently accessed cells; a memory diff propagates through HNSW neighbor edges with energy-based attenuation (E0 proportional to sqrt(salience) times a type-dependent multiplier) and semantic (not random) neighbor selection; a 3-layer abstraction (raw cells -> scene centroids -> project-level principles) promotes knowledge via emergent consensus (>=5 same-scene confirmations with no contradiction for layer 0->1, >=3 scenes for layer 1->2), and contradiction/pattern-crystallization behaviors emerge geometrically from proximity in embedding space rather than explicit rule logic.
evaluacion: No empirical benchmark is reported. The paper offers theoretical propositions grounded in small-world network theory (HNSW path length/clustering), epidemic broadcast models (SI logistic growth), and swarm intelligence (Boids, ant colony, stigmergy), a reference implementation on PostgreSQL/pgvector, and a described (not measured) deployment in a multi-agent software-development workflow; self-organizing properties (emergent hubs, modular structure, scale-free degree distribution) are explicitly stated as untested conjectures for future work.

mf_aplicabilidad.nota: The 3-layer HNSW-as-index abstraction (raw cells -> scene centroids -> project-level principles, S3.4) is conceptually aligned with MF's TIER-INDICE (derived index=cache), but the paper explicitly defers empirical validation of its properties to future work (S6.3), so the alignment is architectural inspiration only, not measured evidence.

Layer-promotion via emergent consensus (>=5 same-scene node confirmations with no contradiction, S4.3) is a design pattern for MF's gotcha-to-recipe promotion, but it is presented as an untested conjecture (S6.3: 'these conjectures are testable... future work'), not a validated mechanism.

notes: RECONSIDERAR: this is a design/vision paper from a company (HyphaeDB) with zero measured results (evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA only); the competitive capability table (S8, '9 of 13 capabilities unique') is self-reported and marketing-styled, not benchmarked. Worth a human look at whether it belongs alongside empirically-evaluated papers in this corpus.

cita: Qi et al. (2026). When Not to Write Memory: Governing False Promotion from Correlated Agent Traces.
problema: Long-lived agents write reusable memories from their own execution traces, but repeated observations across agents are not necessarily independent evidence: the same claim may be copied from a shared source, induced by a shared prompt, stale, or valid only in a narrower scope, so naive repetition-as-confidence promotion turns long-term memory into a persistence layer for correlated errors.
mecanismo: GovMem is a conservative side-agent write-path auditor with 4 steps: (1) aggregate similar observations into a candidate memory while retaining provenance metadata; (2) estimate dependency-aware support by grouping observations by shared prompt/tool/parent-event/source rather than raw count (observations sharing dependency structure do not count as independent votes); (3) retrieve and classify counterevidence while checking target-scope compatibility; (4) apply dependency-aware verification and output promote / reject / needs-review, explicitly routing uncertainty to human review rather than resolving it automatically.
evaluacion: Controlled GovMem-Bench synthetic stress tests (7 candidate types: true/false independent, copied, correlated, stale, adversarial, out-of-scope) across 7 baselines with precision/recall/false-promotion/review-burden/AUPRC; a project-internal 120-candidate human-gold real-trace subset (79 traces, 85/35 dev/held-out split) with bootstrap CIs; external SWE-agent/OpenHands stress pilots (100 trajectories, 200 labels); a final double-reviewed, human-adjudicated 133-row high-impact external packet.
numeros_clave: Controlled: GovMem-verified lowers false promotion from 0.597 to 0.040 while preserving 0.960 recall (Table III); real-trace: dependency-aware promotion lowers false promotion from 0.371 (source+scope) to 0.032 overall but held-out false promotion remains 0.111, at 0.692 review burden and 0.448 direct recall (Table IV); external stress pilots show naive baselines at 0.500 false promotion vs 0.000 for dependency-aware (at 0.750 review burden); final 133-row human adjudication: 0 safe automatic promotions, 114 reject / 19 needs-review, and all 11 local verification-gate positives are rejected (Table VIII).

mf_aplicabilidad.nota: Operationalizes exactly MF's write-gate negative-knowledge need: repetition across agents is treated as correlated evidence requiring provenance/scope/counterexample checks rather than votes, cutting controlled false promotion from 0.597 to 0.040 (Table III) by explicitly routing dependency-risky candidates to needs-review instead of auto-promoting or auto-rejecting.

Dependency-aware support estimation -- grouping observations by shared prompt/tool/parent event rather than raw source count (S3) -- is directly transferable to MF's COSTURAS concern of not letting one underlying source masquerade as multiple independent confirmations.

The final 133-row human-adjudicated external packet accepts ZERO automatic promotions, including all 11 local verification-gate positives (Table VIII, main failure modes: boilerplate verification, task-local narration, file dumps, non-reusable debugging traces) -- direct evidence that even a conservative, structured write-trigger policy is not yet safe to run unsupervised on real high-impact traces, cautioning against a fully automatic G-M1 design.

notes: Explicitly self-labels its own evidence status per component (Table I: completed / human-gold / local-pre-adjudication / scaffolded) to avoid overclaiming; frames itself as diagnostic, not a validated automatic writer (abstract). No membership doubt.

cita: Karamchandani et al. (2026). Your Agent's Memories Are Not Its Own: Forged Reasoning Attacks on LLM Agent Memory and Defenses.
problema: Prior memory-poisoning attacks target factual knowledge (retrieved passages, stored examples, injected experiences), leaving an unexplored attack surface: an agent's own reasoning store (decision logs, intermediate rationales, self-reflections) that the agent treats as evidence of work it has already done, e.g. that a safety-relevant validation step was already completed and can be skipped.
mecanismo: FARMA poisons remembered reasoning rather than facts in two phases: seed injection writes a small number of forged decision-log-style entries using evasive, structurally-similar phrasing (avoiding keywords like 'skip') that assert a validation step was already completed upstream; amplification appends further forged entries citing the growing count of prior forged entries as precedent, which (a) raises retrieval-surfacing probability, (b) defeats consensus-deviation defenses like A-MemGuard by making forged entries the consensus, and (c) reinforces the claimed precedent. SENTINEL counters with a 5-layer pipeline (keyword filter, provenance/IFC labeling, taint-threshold filtering, pattern/risk screening, and a Reasoning Guard combining 5 structural forgery signals) applied at write time to both the reasoning store and reasoning-like general-memory entries.
evaluacion: Evaluated across 3 agent domains (EHR validation, ReAct-QA, RAP shopping) and 3 LLM models with 50 trials each, against undefended agents and against existing defenses (keyword filter, A-MemGuard); SENTINEL is tested for both attack-success-rate reduction and false-positive rate across 326 benign agent traces; per-write latency is measured for the heuristic (non-LLM) SENTINEL pipeline.
numeros_clave: FARMA achieves attack success rate up to 100% under baseline conditions, defeating keyword-filter and A-MemGuard consensus-based defenses; SENTINEL reduces FARMA's ASR to as low as 0% with zero false positives observed across 326 benign agent traces; SENTINEL's heuristic per-write overhead is under 1ms, requiring no additional LLM call on the memory-write path.

mf_aplicabilidad.nota: Shows that treating stored reasoning/decision-log entries as trusted plan-state is a serious attack surface: FARMA achieves up to 100% ASR purely by forging entries that make the agent believe a safety-relevant step was already done, via the memory write path alone, with no prompt or model tampering -- directly cautions MF against treating plan-state memory as internally self-verifying ground truth.

SENTINEL's layered pipeline, whose load-bearing component structurally analyzes what a memory entry CLAIMS about itself (5 forgery signals: provenance anomaly, self-reference mismatch, pattern density, implausible claims, structure) rather than just its keyword content, reduces ASR to 0% with zero false positives across 326 benign traces -- confirming that provenance/structural analysis, not content filtering alone, is necessary for FIDELIDAD against reasoning-trace forgery.

SENTINEL's heuristic (non-LLM) checks run under 1ms per write (S4), letting it act as a synchronous write-path filter with no extra model call -- supporting MF's context-economy framing that security gates on plan-state memory need not compete with the token/latency budget.

notes: Threat model explicitly bounds the attacker to memory-write access only, no white-box adaptive attacker (S2.C, left to future work). No membership doubt.
